editorial:
Franklin is a quiet, lonely guy who spends most of his time alone. When he cheats on his partner with a mysterious woman he meets on a dating app, he thinks it is just a one-time mistake. But this woman is not who she says she is, and soon Franklin finds himself trapped in a dangerous game of obsession and lies. The movie pulls you in right away with its dark, tense mood and keeps you guessing about who is really in control. You will feel the tension build as Franklin's life starts to fall apart around him.

The acting is strong, especially from the lead, who makes you feel his fear and confusion. The pacing is quick and never drags, with plenty of twists to keep you on edge. Some scenes feel a bit over the top, and the story can be hard to follow at times, but the suspense makes up for it. If you enjoy dark thrillers with mind games, this one is worth your time.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Franklin discovers the mysterious woman has been working with his partner the whole time. The affair was a setup to push him out of his own life and take his money. Franklin tries to fight back, but he is too late. The last shot shows the woman and his partner walking away together, leaving Franklin alone and broken. The twist reveals that the real danger was never the stranger, but the person closest to him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark thrillers with twists and mind games.
